name: SQLite
about: A relational database engine that runs inside the application as a library and keeps each database in a single file.

facts.note: The code is in the public domain; outside contributions are not accepted.
Newest version number; patch releases for older branches (3.53.6, 3.50.8, 3.44.7) came out later, on 2026-11-13. No end-of-support date is stated.
